guides.title: Where to stay in Nyali: studios, apartments and group stays
guides.summary: Compare Nyali studios and apartments by layout, kitchen, pool and group needs. Browse current units and learn what to confirm before booking.
guides.intro: Choosing a stay in Nyali is easier when you begin with how you will use the apartment. A compact studio with a kitchenette serves a different trip from a three-bedroom apartment with a lounge, while a residence with a restaurant may change how you organise meals. This guide connects those choices to the units currently listed through PwaniStays.
sections: Start with the layout, then compare the residence

For a solo trip or a couple, compare studios and one-bedroom apartments by the actual sleeping arrangement and kitchen setup. A studio may place the bed and living space together; a one-bedroom listing does not automatically mean there is a separate workspace. For a group, confirm the beds in each room and whether any extra sleeping spaces are included in the quoted rate.

Nyali listings include named residences such as Aqua Gardens and Pavilion Suites. Compare each unit separately: an apartment at one residence may list a gym and play area, while another lists an on-site restaurant or supermarket. Facilities should be checked on the specific unit page rather than assumed from the area name.
Plan around meals, work and everyday errands

If you expect to prepare meals, compare a kitchenette with a fully equipped kitchen and ask which appliances and utensils are provided. For a longer visit, laundry access and housekeeping frequency may matter more than a decorative feature. Ask whether cleaning or electricity charges are included in the quotation.

For remote work, a Wi-Fi label is only a starting point. Request recent connection information, a suitable work surface and details of backup arrangements if uninterrupted work is essential. When a nearby shop or beach is mentioned, ask for the location pin and the route you would actually use.
Pool access and family needs

A shared pool is different from a pool reserved for your group. Confirm access hours and any building rules before booking. For children, ask about balcony security, pool supervision requirements and whether cots or extra bedding can be arranged. A children’s play area in one listing is not a promise that every Nyali apartment has one.
faq: Can I book a Nyali apartment for a longer stay?

Send your proposed dates and guest count so PwaniStays can check the specific unit. Ask for a written total covering housekeeping, utilities and any additional charges; a long-stay discount is not automatic.
Does a Nyali listing guarantee beach access?
No. Check the exact property location and access route. A sea view, an area name and direct beachfront access describe different things.

guides.title: Where to stay in Diani: beachfront studios, villas and longer visits
guides.summary: Compare Diani beachfront studios, pool villas and two-bedroom stays. Check beach access, pool privacy, kitchens and laundry before requesting rates.
guides.intro: For a Diani stay, first decide whether being directly beside the beach matters more than having a particular layout or pool arrangement. PwaniStays listings include beachfront studios, villa accommodation and multi-bedroom stays. Their facilities vary, so the useful comparison is between individual units rather than an assumption that every Diani property offers the same beach holiday.
sections: Separate beachfront position from the room view

A beachfront listing describes the property’s position. It does not necessarily establish a sea view from the room, private use of the beach or a step-free path to the sand. If a listing describes the beach as a walk away, request the location pin and access route instead of treating a quoted walking time as guaranteed.

Look through the photographs for the room and living layout, then ask which part of the property they show. If you need direct beach access for your daily plans, make that a specific requirement in your enquiry. This is especially useful when comparing an ocean-facing studio with a villa whose main appeal is its pool.
Clarify what private pool access includes

Pool wording deserves a separate question. A listing with private swimming pool access may have different arrangements from an entire property with a pool reserved exclusively for one group. Confirm who else can use it, whether it is shared with other accommodation and what access hours apply.

Air conditioning and a kitchenette can be useful when comparing smaller units, but neither confirms the guest limit. Use the host’s stated sleeping arrangement, and ask about extra guests before booking. For families, also confirm pool safety arrangements and any restrictions on children.
For a longer visit, compare kitchens and laundry

A two-bedroom Diani listing may offer a living area, kitchen and washing machine, whereas a compact studio may focus on a smaller layout. Choose around the routine you expect: cooking, laundry and time indoors can matter during a longer visit. Ask about the equipment provided and whether laundry use or cleaning carries an extra charge.

Include your arrival plans in the enquiry so check-in and transfer options can be discussed. Transport time depends on the route and conditions; it should be confirmed for your actual arrival rather than inferred from an area description.
faq: No. Some listings explicitly state beachfront, while others describe proximity to the beach. Confirm the exact position and route on the unit you choose.
Can I reserve directly from the property page?
The page sends an enquiry with your dates and guest count. PwaniStays confirms availability, the total rate and booking terms in writing before a booking is agreed.

guides.title: Where to stay in Shanzu: ocean views, rooftop pools and access details
guides.summary: Compare Shanzu one-bedroom apartments and penthouses by sea view, balcony, rooftop pool and access. Browse units and ask for date-specific rates.
guides.intro: Shanzu listings can look similar at first glance, especially when several offer one bedroom, air conditioning and Wi-Fi. The details that change a stay are often more specific: which room has the ocean view, whether the balcony is private, how the rooftop pool is accessed and whether there are stairs. Use those questions to build a shortlist from the current PwaniStays units below.
sections: Choose the view and balcony you actually want

If an ocean view is your main reason for choosing a unit, check which rooms face the water and how the balcony connects to the living space. A sea-view listing does not establish that the building is directly on the beach. Ask for the exact location and the route to beach access.

Some Shanzu listings describe a private balcony and a rooftop swimming pool. Compare these as separate features: a private balcony does not mean the pool is exclusive to your reservation. Confirm the pool’s access hours, shared-use arrangements and building rules.
Check penthouse and rooftop access before committing

A penthouse description tells you little about the route from parking to the apartment. Ask about the floor, lift availability, any remaining flights of stairs and access to shared facilities. This is especially important with luggage, children or a traveller who needs step-free access.

Balcony safety and rooftop pool arrangements also deserve direct questions when travelling with children. Photographs can help you identify the layout, but they do not replace confirmation of accessibility or supervision requirements. Include those needs in your initial enquiry.
Compare the practical facilities behind similar titles

For a one-bedroom apartment, check the bed arrangement and stated guest limit rather than assuming it can accommodate extra people. Compare kitchenettes and kitchens by the equipment you expect to use. Some listings mention drinking water provided; confirm that on the individual unit rather than assuming it applies throughout Shanzu.

Wi-Fi and a Smart TV may appear across several listings, but they do not guarantee a work-ready connection or a streaming subscription. Ask about a work surface, current internet performance and any login requirements. If a beach or hotel is described as nearby, request a location pin instead of relying on a fixed walking time.
faq: Does a rooftop pool mean private use?
No. Confirm whether other residents or guests use it and whether access has set hours. Only a written confirmation for the chosen unit can establish exclusive use.
Are Shanzu penthouses accessible without stairs?
The listing title does not establish accessibility. Ask for the route from arrival to the unit, including lifts and any stairs to the apartment or pool.
